Name: Dryads of the Valley(Alternate Sheet)
Author: Jknight3135
Description:
This is an alternate sprite sheet for [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/986/?]hgjj's Dryads of the valley[/url] I have only modified his work. His mod includes a female version and a futa version but I decided that they weren't quite well enough endowed and so this mod makes them a bit more noticeable.

The dryads will be erect during the season they produce fruit and will leave a mess the follwing season after all the fun they had.

I may add more alternate versions I'm working on one where the dryads are pregnant and feel free to make suggestions if you like.

Again all credit for the original artwork goes to hgjj and I have posted this with his approval.
